linkedin.activityText: Lewis Howes Lewis Howes 8h Lewis Howes shared this Your body often notices what your mind is still trying to rationalize. 🙌 Trust yourself enough to listen. Your mind can process the details later. Have you ever had a gut feeling that ended up being right? 💭 Lewis Howes Lewis Howes 12h Lewis Howes shared this Men trade money advice constantly. Women are taught it's gross to bring it up. Emma Grede listens to her husband on the phone with his friends, swapping notes on investments, crypto, lawyers, and deal structures. She realized she'd never had one of those calls with her girlfriends. At a panel literally called "Women, Power and Money," a woman told her she talks about money too much. But nobody is coming to pull you out of obscurity and hand you what you want. If you don't ask, you don't get. What money conversation have you been avoiding? Lewis Howes Lewis Howes 20h Lewis Howes shared this There’s something powerful about trusting the process, even when you can’t see the full picture yet. You don’t need every answer. You don’t need to know exactly how it’s going to happen. Sometimes you just need enough belief to keep moving forward. 🙏 What’s something you’re choosing to trust will work out right now? 💭 Lewis Howes Lewis Howes 22h Lewis Howes shared this Research says women are attracted to men for three core reasons. The third is the one people least like to admit. First is kindness. Being good to your parents and going out of your way to help people, with no expectation of anything back. Second is intelligence, because smarter people make better decisions and protect their families. The fastest way to show it? Humor. Third is the ability to signal future resources. Not being rich now, but having your act together enough to look like a reliable provider. The catch is that fewer and fewer men fit that description. Which of these three are you building right now? Lewis Howes Lewis Howes 1d Lewis Howes shared this The seasons where nothing seems to be happening are often the seasons where everything is taking shape. 🙏 Trust the process. Your consistency, love, and dedication matter more than you realize. What are you choosing to keep believing in right now? 💭 Lewis Howes Lewis Howes 1d Lewis Howes shared this Success doesn't mean the work of getting noticed is over. Jo Koy has a Netflix special and three sold-out shows in Miami this weekend. He still asked his graphics guy for 10,000 fliers to hand out himself. His reasoning: plenty of people have never heard of him, and thinking otherwise would take a special kind of ego. He isn't asking everyone to like him. He's asking for a chance. Watch ten minutes, and if it isn't for you, that's fine. The work of showing up never really ends, no matter how far you get. Where have you stopped introducing yourself because you assumed people already knew?
